I thought one day you'd learn
it's my life not your concern
I know it's too late
But I just cant seem to relate
If you knew all along
That we can't just move along
Then why let it go through
And why break my heart in two ----
The past now is just a dream.
And unreal is what it seems
I know you know I know you well
But secrets you just wont tell
And I thought I'd found you
The one who would treat me true.
I learned that it cant be
I know now that nothing is free.
The prices find a way
To be too high for us to pay
I am all I can be
So please tell the truth to me
You said ---
The past now is just a dream.
And unreal is what it seems
I know you know I know you well
But secrets you just wont tell
